svg.desc: Panel a: vLLM-Omni p95 longest playback gap against frames in the first packet; measured gaps of 449, 368, 207 and 0 ms follow a model of a 528 ms wait for the first 25-frame block minus the audio already delivered. Panel b: recorded chunk arrivals replayed with startup buffers from 0 to 400 ms; each buffer millisecond moves a condition one millisecond right and down, so only concurrency 1 briefly enters the region where both SLOs are met.
